API ReferenceZscaler Cloud & Branch Connector APIPolicy ResourcesGet Source Ip Groups
Get Source Ip Groups
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/ztw/api/v1/ipSourceGroups

Retrieves the list of source IP groups. To learn more, see About Source IP Groups.

Request
​
QUERY PARAMETERS
search
string

The search string used to match against the source IP group parameters, such as name and IP addresses.

Responses
​
default

Default Response

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
Array [
id
int32

ID of the IP address group or IP pool.

name
string

Name of the IP address group or IP pool.

ipAddresses
string[]

IP addresses included in the IP group or IP pool.

description
string

Description of the IP group or IP pool.

creatorContext
string

Indicates whether the IP group or IP pool is created in Cloud & Branch Connector (EC) or ZIA.

Possible values: [ZIA, EC]

isNonEditable
boolean

Indicates if the IP group is view-only (true) or is editable (false).

]
